start_here: Say to your AI: "What times are open on my TidyCal Application Call between 1 and 3 December?" It runs tool:list-tidycal-timeslots.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads which times TidyCal shows open and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Get the booking type id with tool:list-my-tidycal-booking-types.
2. Say the window to your AI. It calls tools:run with tool tool:list-tidycal-timeslots, booking_type_id, starts_at and ends_at (ISO 8601 UTC).
3. Read each open slot's start time. Book only a slot listed here.
4. To book one of those slots, say so to your AI: it runs tool:create-a-tidycal-booking with the same booking_type_id and that start time.

worked_examples.title: Open times for Application Call on 1 December
worked_examples.ask: What times are open on my Application Call on 1 December?
worked_examples.given: Reads tools/tidycal/tool-rows.json: a GET to https://tidycal.com/api/booking-types/{booking_type_id}/timeslots with the vault key tidycal-api-token. Reads only.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answers the open slots, for example a slot starting 2026-12-01T16:00:00Z. The real times are read from the live TidyCal answer when the row runs.
